rule_questions: Engagement 'same' rests on a trial paper's PD-biomarker result (Maher 2021) that restates the preclinical premise in its introduction, not on a formal model-vs-patient comparison. The cf-cftr house example (Ramsey 2011 sweat chloride) uses the same pattern, so accepted; the brief should state explicitly that this counts as 'the comparison'.

Dose cell when no model ever set an exposure target: empty, or 'untested' dated to the first year the model was dosed (rule 6)? The draft dated it to the patient-side paper (2021), which the rules do not support; I proposed 2014 but 2002 (Belperio) or empty are both defensible.

Safety cell with 'Nonclinical toxicology' as the model: the package is unpublished, so rule 6 (open at first model use) cannot be applied and the entry defaults to the trial year. The brief should say whether that is the intended convention (ad-amyloid does the same).

Year convention: the draft uses print years (Parker epub Aug 2017/print Jan 2018; Maher epub Oct 2020/print Feb 2021). The brief does not say print vs epub; the house examples appear to use print years, so accepted.
